gloss: outline; gist; main thread; general idea

definitions.explanation: The general framework or main points of something, without the details.

examples.japanese: ⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{大筋|おおすじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}した→説明する：05639_setsumeisuru⟧。
examples.english: I explained the outline of the plan.

examples.japanese: {大筋|おおすじ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{合意|ごうい}→合意：05093_goui⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{大筋|おおすじ}⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦{教|おし}えて→教える：00526_oshieru⟧。
examples.english: Just tell me the gist of the movie.

notes:
FORMS:
{大|おお} (big, main) + ⟦{筋|すじ}→筋：03366_suji⟧ (line, thread) → main thread = outline

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {大筋|おおすじ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ - in general terms, in principle
- {大筋|おおすじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}する→説明する：05639_setsumeisuru⟧ - to explain the outline
- {大筋|おおすじ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{合意|ごうい}→合意：05093_goui⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ - to agree in principle
- ⟦{物語|ものがたり}→物語：03634_monogatari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{大筋|おおすじ} - the plot outline

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{概略|がいりゃく}→概略：07768_gairyaku⟧ - summary, outline
- ⟦{概要|がいよう}→概要：06747_gaiyou⟧ - overview
- ⟦{要旨|ようし}→要旨：04087_youshi⟧ - gist, main point
- あらすじ - plot summary (stories)

USAGE:
{大筋|おおすじ} emphasizes the main flow or structure, leaving aside minor details.
